title: Scaling test-time compute with open models
publication_date_evidence: author Reddit announcement; article citation specifies year 2024
problem: 公开模型上如何复现按难度与预算选择搜索策略的收益。
insight: 验证器引导搜索与保留独立子树的DVTS互补，最优策略随题目难度和预算变化。
method: Llama 1B/3B策略模型、8B PRM、MATH-500、1–256候选、五随机种子；比较多数投票、BoN、beam search和DVTS。
result: 作者报告在部分预算设置中小策略模型系统超过大模型基线；以生成预算为主要横轴。
limitation: 额外8B验证器与搜索不是零成本，未给统一端到端FLOPs比较；难度分桶可能使用离线信息；主要证据局限数学。

title: Helix 2.5: Zero-Shot 30-Home Generalization
publication_date_evidence: Date printed on the official Figure report
problem: 能否预测人类行为预训练数据对机器人迁移的收益，而不混淆离线损失和闭环成功。
insight: 固定模型与下游训练，扫描人类数据规模；另用预训练消融检查未见家庭中的任务执行。
method: Four nested Index subsets spanning 8x data; fixed model size and downstream training; held-out action-prediction loss. Separate pretraining ablation across three behaviors and 30 unseen homes.
result: Largest-run loss forecast error reported as 0.54% of loss variation over the measured data range; separate whole-task success comparison 9% versus 56%.
limitation: Developer-reported evidence with four scale points; no joint compute/model law or arbitrary-task success extrapolation. Zero-shot concerns homes and objects, not absence of task-specific training. No independent replication by this survey.

title: A study of sequence weighting at scale
branch: 有效数据与混合跨尺度迁移
problem: 小规模模型的数据权重响应能否外推到大规模？
insight: 随机序列权重的响应指数随模型规模非单调，并随训练轮数改变；把权重效应从领域质量差异中分离。
limitation: 内部基准；测量同训练集损失下降而非泛化；权重补偿建议未实验验证。

evidence_strength: B: author experiment; internal data; no independent replication
metadata_notes: Publication date is printed in the article, not inferred from crawler time; no revision date supplied.
method: Random log-uniform sequence weights in [0.01, 10], three model families and three epochs; effective exponent fitted to same-training-set loss reductions.
result: Non-monotonic weight-response trend across model scales; epoch count moves its peak.

title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents
branch: 架构、优化配方与预训练指数
problem: 架构变化是否只能移动规模曲线常数？
insight: 按架构拟合训练配方，分离边界算子、权重共享与训练中增长；在测量区间中增长的等损失计算优势随规模扩大。
limitation: 固定批大小；共用由基线估计的不可约损失；远距离外推未验证；跨GPT-3约20倍比较非受控。
sections_read: Abstract; §§1–4; selected §5/data-constrained results; Appendix B.5, C.1–C.5, D.1–D.2. Other appendix tuning grids and figures not fully audited.
evidence_strength: B: controlled author experiments in a finite scale range; no independent replication
metadata_notes: arXiv submission history verifies dates. v2 changes v1 abstract wording from exponential to power-law improvements; summary follows v2.
method: Architecture-specific compute-optimal ladders on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu; boundary-operator, weight-sharing and training-growth comparisons; held-out 7.4B run.
result: Untied-Grow loss-matched compute multiplier over Vanilla increases from 1.30x near 1e18 FLOPs to 1.55x near 1e20 on FineWeb. A larger held-out run tests limited extrapolation; 1e25 FLOPs remains a forecast.

title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity
problem: 总参数或激活参数相同的 MoE 仍可能需要不同的学习率和 batch；稀疏度变化使小实验超参数迁移失效。
insight: 将专家激活比例 A 作为独立预测变量，分别以 (C,A) 和 (D,A) 拟合峰值学习率与全局 token batch；留组预测并在预先冻结的超稀疏配置上检验。
limitation: 单一骨干、语料、Muon、路由与调度；一个联合外推目标；激活参数量未超出拟合范围；全网格多种子覆盖不足；候选函数区间重叠；不构成下游能力定律。
sections_read: 核验 arXiv 作者和完整版本历史；重点阅读 v1 HTML 摘要、§1–4.4、§6–7，查阅 §5；未审计附录 A–C、未视觉复核图像、未运行实验。
method: Expert activation ratio supplements the existing scale variables in multiplicative power-law models for peak LR and global token batch. The gradient-noise explanation in §3.2 is an author-proposed mechanism; its Appendix C derivation was not audited. Leave-one-activation-ratio-out and leave-one-active-scale-out at whole loss-surface level; optimum extraction and fitting use training folds. Their primary grouped errors concern hyperparameter coordinates, not validation-loss predictions.
result: Within the studied recipe, increasing sparsity shifts the preferred learning rate downward at fixed compute and token batch upward at fixed data; one frozen joint-extrapolation target lies near the observed optimum.

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
problem: 固定人类语料后，来自网页的 AI 文本是否仍能按正的有效 token 计入；混合验证集会不会遮蔽人类文本上的退化？

limitation: 800 个不足 1B 的模型、单配方、英语、检测器标签；添加数据增加计算量；loss 不等于能力；保留大规模实验同时参与候选形式比较，不能称为完全独立的最终测试；未复现。

method: Fix human corpus and add detector-labeled wild AI text; fit a saturating effective-data term plus harm, evaluate human/AI/mixed targets separately. Fit 726 small runs and reserve 74 larger runs, also used in functional-form comparisons.

title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
problem: 压缩方法、配置和初始模型不同会产生不同的分任务损失；能否减少拟合测量，并证明数值预测确实改善部署选择？

title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
problem: 第一人称人类视频缺少躯干运动学且动作标注含噪；数据量与开环代理指标未必对应真实机器人成功率
insight: 用相机坐标动作和跨具身语义维度对齐减少显式身体重定向，单独比较数据扩展、动作坐标和辅助世界先验
limitation: 一种架构/数据混合、一个机器人平台、六项OOD任务每项10次；约40,000段目标机器人演示用于后训练，非无机器人数据迁移；预训练小时包含人类及非目标机器人数据；部分开环prior结果按同一次运行多checkpoint平均；无全成本/跨种子或独立复现保证
sections_read: 原站元数据和版本史；v1摘要、§3.1–3.3数据/表示/模型/训练、§4.1–4.5设置/多层评估/数据扩展/消融和§5局限；未视觉审计图7/10或代码、无运行复现

method: Camera-space action alignment across human and non-target robot sources; fixed architecture/optimization/robot-data mixture while adding human video; subsequent IRON-R01 adaptation and separate open-/closed-loop tests.
